sentence: LET ME TELL YOU ABOUT A LITTLE BOY NAMED THOMAS, WHO SPENT THE FIRST YEAR OF HIS LIFE IN A HOSPITAL BED. THE EQUIPMENT THAT KEPT HIM ALIVE WAS PAID FOR BY VIEWERS EXACTLY LIKE YOU, ON A NIGHT EXACTLY LIKE THIS ONE. THOMAS IS SEVEN NOW, AND HE IS WATCHING WITH US TONIGHT, AND HE WOULD LIKE TO SAY THANK YOU.

OF COURSE THE LANE I AM IN IS THE SLOWEST. OF COURSE IT IS. THE OTHER LANE WAS MOVING EXCELLENTLY UNTIL I MERGED INTO IT, AT WHICH POINT IT TURNED INTO TREACLE, AND THE LANE I HAD BEEN IN STARTED FLOWING LIKE THE NILE. THIS IS A LAW OF PHYSICS. I DID NOT WRITE IT. I JUST LIVE INSIDE IT, IN A SLIGHTLY DIFFERENT LANE EACH TIME.

WE HAVE JUST RECEIVED A WONDERFUL ANONYMOUS PLEDGE OF FIVE THOUSAND POUNDS FROM A GENEROUS VIEWER IN THE NORTH, AND THE WHOLE STUDIO IS ON ITS FEET. THANK YOU, WHOEVER YOU ARE. BUT DO NOT LET THAT BIG NUMBER MAKE YOU THINK YOUR SMALLER GIFT DOES NOT MATTER, BECAUSE IT MATTERS MORE THAN YOU WILL EVER KNOW TO THE FAMILIES WE SERVE.

I HAVE ASKED FOUR TIMES FOR THE ASSEMBLY INSTRUCTIONS IN ENGLISH AND BEEN SENT THE SAME PDF IN DUTCH ON ALL FOUR OCCASIONS. I DO NOT SPEAK DUTCH. I DO NOT WANT TO LEARN DUTCH. I WOULD LIKE A CHAIR THAT IS ACTUALLY A CHAIR, ASSEMBLED IN A WAY THAT MAKES SENSE TO MY ENGLISH-LANGUAGE BRAIN, AND I WOULD LIKE TO STOP RECEIVING AUTOMATED REPLIES THANKING ME FOR MY PATIENCE.

I HAVE SPENT THE ENTIRE MORNING ON HOLD WITH THE BANK AND I AM NOW ON MY THIRD PERSON, NONE OF WHOM CAN APPARENTLY ACCESS THE SAME SYSTEM AS THE LAST ONE. I JUST WANT TO TRANSFER MY OWN MONEY OUT OF MY OWN ACCOUNT INTO ANOTHER OF MY OWN ACCOUNTS. THIS SHOULD NOT REQUIRE A COMMITTEE.

HELLO FRIEND, I AM A SENIOR BANK OFFICIAL WRITING TO YOU IN STRICT CONFIDENCE ABOUT A DORMANT ACCOUNT BELONGING TO A DECEASED CLIENT WHO SHARES YOUR SURNAME. I PROPOSE THAT WE PRESENT YOU AS THE NEXT OF KIN AND SPLIT THE CONSIDERABLE BALANCE EQUALLY BETWEEN US. THIS IS COMPLETELY LEGAL AND RISK-FREE, AND I AWAIT YOUR PROMPT AND DISCREET RESPONSE.

I HAVE TRIED EVERY POSSIBLE PASSWORD I HAVE EVER USED, INCLUDING THE EMBARRASSING ONES, AND NOTHING IS WORKING. THE WEBSITE HAS NOW LOCKED ME OUT FOR TWENTY-FOUR HOURS, WHICH FEELS LIKE A PUNISHMENT WILDLY OUT OF PROPORTION TO THE CRIME OF FORGETTING. I WILL BE LOGGING IN TOMORROW AT 9:01 A.M. WITH A FOUL EXPRESSION AND A NOTE-TO-SELF NEVER TO USE THIS SERVICE AGAIN.

WELCOME TO YOUR FRIDAY NIGHT BINGO, AND WHAT A LOVELY CROWD WE HAVE IN TONIGHT. BOOKS ARE STILL ON SALE AT THE DESK BY THE DOOR, FLYER TICKETS ARE A POUND EACH, AND THE FIRST GAME BEGINS IN FIVE MINUTES. GET YOUR DABBERS UNCAPPED, GET YOUR LUCKY CHARMS ARRANGED, AND PLEASE TURN YOUR MOBILE TELEPHONES TO SILENT FOR EVERYONE'S SAKE.

INTRODUCING FIRST, MAKING HER PROFESSIONAL DEBUT IN FRONT OF HER HOMETOWN CROWD, A DECORATED AMATEUR WITH OVER SIXTY CONTESTS TO HER NAME. AND HER OPPONENT, A SEASONED VETERAN WHO HAS NEVER ONCE BEEN STOPPED INSIDE THE DISTANCE. SIX ROUNDS OF LIGHTWEIGHT BOXING, AND THE WHOLE BUILDING IS BEHIND THE LOCAL GIRL AS SHE BEGINS HER JOURNEY.

PERJURY IS A CRIME. I REMIND THE WITNESS, NOT FOR THE FIRST TIME, THAT HE IS UNDER OATH AND THAT HIS TESTIMONY UNDER THAT OATH IS CONTRADICTED BY THE WRITTEN STATEMENT HE PROVIDED TO INVESTIGATORS IN JANUARY. WHICH OF THESE ACCOUNTS IS TRUE? WHEN YOU FIGURE THAT OUT, PLEASE LET ME KNOW SO I CAN INSTRUCT THE JURY ACCORDINGLY.

YOU HAVE IGNORED OUR PREVIOUS LETTERS AND THAT WAS A SERIOUS MISTAKE. THE FACTORY WILL NOT REOPEN AND THE WORKERS WILL NOT BE PAID UNTIL THE MANAGEMENT AGREES TO MEET US AT THE NEGOTIATING TABLE. WE ARE NOT BLUFFING, WE ARE NOT GOING AWAY, AND EVERY DAY YOU DELAY ONLY HARDENS OUR RESOLVE. THE NEXT MOVE BELONGS ENTIRELY TO YOU.

DEAR VALUED CUSTOMER, OUR RECORDS INDICATE THAT YOU ARE OWED A TAX REFUND FROM THE PREVIOUS FINANCIAL YEAR. THE AMOUNT IS READY TO BE TRANSFERRED ONCE YOU COMPLETE THE BRIEF VERIFICATION FORM ATTACHED TO THIS MESSAGE. PLEASE PROVIDE YOUR SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER AND A SCANNED COPY OF YOUR IDENTIFICATION TO AVOID ANY DELAY IN PROCESSING YOUR REBATE.

ROCKALL, MALIN, HEBRIDES. WIND SOUTH-EASTERLY GALE EIGHT TO STORM TEN, VEERING SOUTHERLY AND DECREASING SEVERE GALE NINE LATER. SEA STATE HIGH, OCCASIONALLY VERY HIGH. WEATHER RAIN, HEAVY AT TIMES. VISIBILITY MODERATE OR POOR. ALL VESSELS IN THESE WATERS SHOULD SEEK SHELTER WHERE POSSIBLE AND POSTPONE ANY NON-ESSENTIAL PASSAGE.

MASSIVE WAREHOUSE CLEAROUT! ELECTRONICS, APPLIANCES, AND HOMEWARE AT BELOW WHOLESALE PRICES. WE NEED THE SPACE FOR NEW STOCK AND THE PRICES REFLECT IT. CHECK OUT THE BOXED-IMPERFECT SECTION FOR DEEPER DISCOUNTS ON ITEMS WITH MINOR PACKAGING DAMAGE. EVERYTHING CARRIES A FULL MANUFACTURER WARRANTY. THIS IS THE BIGGEST SALE OF THE YEAR.

WE HAVE SEEN SINGERS, WE HAVE SEEN DANCERS, WE HAVE SEEN A MAN BALANCE A LADDER ON HIS CHIN. BUT NOTHING, AND I MEAN NOTHING, HAS PREPARED THIS AUDIENCE FOR WHAT IS ABOUT TO HAPPEN ON THIS STAGE. KEEP YOUR EYES OPEN, KEEP AN OPEN MIND, AND PLEASE WELCOME AN ACT QUITE UNLIKE ANYTHING IN THE HISTORY OF THIS SHOW.

DISK SPACE CRITICALLY LOW. ONLY 137 MEGABYTES REMAIN ON THE SYSTEM DRIVE. PERFORMANCE MAY DEGRADE AND CERTAIN APPLICATIONS MAY FAIL TO LAUNCH UNTIL ADDITIONAL SPACE IS RECOVERED. CONSIDER EMPTYING THE RECYCLE BIN, REMOVING TEMPORARY INTERNET FILES, OR UNINSTALLING APPLICATIONS YOU NO LONGER USE. CLICK THE BUTTON BELOW TO LAUNCH THE CLEANUP UTILITY.

OPEN ALL NIGHT, HOT COFFEE AND FRESH DONUTS, COME ON IN. THE LIGHTS IN THE WINDOW HAVE BEEN BURNING SINCE NINETEEN FIFTY-TWO AND THEY DO NOT GO DARK FOR ANYBODY. WHETHER YOU ARE COMING OFF A LATE SHIFT OR CHASING AN EARLY TRAIN, THERE IS A STOOL AT THE COUNTER WITH YOUR NAME ON IT AND A POT OF SOMETHING STRONG ALWAYS WAITING.

sentence: DEEP IN THE FROZEN FORTRESS, THE ANCIENT MACHINE HUMS BACK TO LIFE. CLANK, GEARS THE SIZE OF CARTWHEELS BEGIN TO TURN, AND DUST OF AGES SHOWERS FROM THE VAULTED CEILING. THE PROPHECY SPOKE OF THIS DAY, THE NARRATION REMINDS US, AND NOW THAT THE KEY HAS BEEN TURNED, NOT EVEN THE GODS THEMSELVES CAN STOP WHAT BEGINS.

PROGRESS IS NOT LINEAR. THE FACT THAT YOU MISSED A WEEK DOES NOT ERASE THE EIGHT WEEKS BEFORE IT, AND IT DOES NOT MEAN YOU HAVE TO START OVER. PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF, MAYBE TEN PERCENT LIGHTER FOR THE FIRST SESSION, AND BUILD FROM THERE. EVERY ATHLETE I HAVE EVER COACHED HAS HAD WEEKS LIKE THIS. THE BEST ONES JUST COME BACK FASTER.

THE BOUT IS DECLARED A MAJORITY DRAW, AND WHAT A GUTSY EFFORT FROM BOTH WARRIORS OVER TEN COMPELLING ROUNDS. NEITHER MAN DESERVED TO LOSE, AND NEITHER MAN WILL GO HOME UNHAPPY WITH WHAT HE SHOWED THE WORLD TONIGHT. A REMATCH SURELY BECKONS, AND IF IT IS HALF AS GOOD AS THIS ONE, EVERY TICKET IN THE HOUSE WILL BE GONE WITHIN THE HOUR.

WINTER STORM WARNING POSTED FOR THE HIGHER ELEVATIONS OF THE CASCADES. EIGHTEEN TO TWENTY-FOUR INCHES OF SNOW ARE EXPECTED ABOVE 4,000 FEET, WITH RIDGETOP WINDS GUSTING TO SEVENTY MILES PER HOUR. TRAVEL OVER STEVENS AND SNOQUALMIE PASSES WILL BE EXTREMELY HAZARDOUS AND MAY BE CLOSED FOR EXTENDED PERIODS WHILE CREWS WORK TO MITIGATE THE AVALANCHE DANGER.

HOOPLA, HOOPLA, THE OLDEST GAME ON THE FAIRGROUND AND STILL THE BEST. RING THE BLOCK AND THE PRIZE THAT SITS ON IT GOES HOME WITH YOU TONIGHT. THERE IS A WATCH ON THE FAR LEFT THAT NOBODY HAS WON ALL WEEK, AND I HAVE A FEELING ABOUT YOU. FIVE RINGS FOR A POUND, AND THE WATCH IS WAITING TO MEET ITS NEW OWNER.

YOUR ATTENTION PLEASE. PLAY HAS BEEN SUSPENDED DUE TO RAIN, AND THE COVERS ARE BEING BROUGHT ON BY THE GROUND STAFF. AT THE POINT OF THE STOPPAGE THE SCORE STOOD AT TWO HUNDRED AND FIVE FOR SEVEN. A FURTHER ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING A POSSIBLE RESUMPTION WILL BE MADE AS SOON AS THE UMPIRES HAVE INSPECTED THE OUTFIELD.

DENSE FOG ADVISORY THROUGH THE MORNING COMMUTE WITH VISIBILITY DROPPING BELOW A QUARTER MILE ACROSS THE LOWER OHIO VALLEY. MOTORISTS SHOULD USE LOW-BEAM HEADLIGHTS, INCREASE FOLLOWING DISTANCES, AND BE PREPARED FOR SUDDEN SLOWDOWNS NEAR RIVER CROSSINGS AND OVERPASSES WHERE THE FOG IS THICKEST AND TENDS TO LINGER WELL PAST SUNRISE.

AND THEY ARE OFF AND RUNNING IN THE FEATURE RACE. THE EARLY SPEED COMES FROM THE RAIL AS THE GREY MARE GRABS THE LEAD INTO THE FIRST TURN. DOWN THE BACKSTRETCH SHE HOLDS A LENGTH AND A HALF, BUT THE FAVOURITE IS MOVING UP NICELY ON THE OUTSIDE, FOUR WIDE, WITH PLENTY LEFT IN THE TANK FOR THE LONG RUN HOME.

DO ONE THING EVERY DAY THAT SCARES YOU. SPEAK UP IN THE MEETING. SIGN UP FOR THE RACE. SEND THE EMAIL YOU HAVE BEEN DRAFTING IN YOUR HEAD FOR THREE WEEKS. COURAGE IS NOT THE ABSENCE OF FEAR BUT THE DECISION TO ACT IN ITS PRESENCE, AND IT GETS EASIER ONLY THROUGH REPETITION. START TODAY. THE FIRST ONE WILL BE THE HARDEST.

ENTRY, MIDDLE WATCH. A LARGE STEAMER PASSED VERY CLOSE TO THE REEF AT TWO O'CLOCK, CLOSER THAN ANY PRUDENT MASTER SHOULD ALLOW. WE SHOWED THE LIGHT AND SOUNDED THE HORN REPEATEDLY UNTIL SHE ALTERED COURSE TO SEAWARD. NO DAMAGE DONE, BUT I HAVE RECORDED HER APPROXIMATE DESCRIPTION FOR THE ATTENTION OF THE BOARD SHOULD ANY ENQUIRY ARISE.

AND NOW, THE MOMENT WE HAVE ALL BEEN WAITING FOR, THE GRAND FINALE. EVERYTHING WE HAVE LEFT IS GOING UP AT ONCE, SO THERE IS NO POINT IN ME TRYING TO DESCRIBE IT. JUST LOOK UP, HOLD YOUR BREATH, AND LET THE SKY DO THE TALKING. THANK YOU ALL FOR COMING, AND HERE, FRIENDS, WE GO.

I DROPPED THE EGG. I DROPPED THE WHOLE EGG. THE SHELL EXPLODED ON IMPACT AND THE YOLK HAS SEEPED UNDER THE OVEN. UNDER. THE. OVEN. WHERE I HAVE NEVER, IN MY ENTIRE TENANCY, CLEANED. I HAVE A FEELING THAT WHEN I MOVE THE OVEN I AM GOING TO DISCOVER AN ENTIRE CIVILISATION DOWN THERE. I AM NOT EMOTIONALLY READY FOR THAT TODAY.

THEY BUILT A FENCE AROUND THE LIBRARY AND PADLOCKED THE DOORS, BUT THEY CANNOT PADLOCK AN IDEA. THAT BUILDING IS WHERE GENERATIONS LEARNED TO READ AND WHERE LONELY PEOPLE FOUND WARMTH AND COMPANY. WE WILL OCCUPY THIS PAVEMENT, WE WILL READ ALOUD ON THESE STEPS, AND WE WILL NOT LEAVE UNTIL THE COUNCIL REVERSES A DECISION THAT NEVER SHOULD HAVE BEEN MADE.

I HEAR THE CROWD CHANTING YOUR NAME, AND I WANT YOU TO ENJOY IT WHILE IT LASTS. CHEERS FADE FAST IN THIS BUSINESS, AND THE ONLY THING THAT MATTERS WHEN THE LIGHTS GO DOWN IS WHO IS STANDING AND WHO IS FLAT ON THEIR BACK. ON SUNDAY THE CHEERING STOPS, THE EXCUSES STOP, AND THE TRUTH FINALLY COMES OUT IN THE MIDDLE OF THAT RING.

ATTENTION ALL PASSENGERS: THE 7:42 SERVICE TO MANCHESTER PICCADILLY HAS BEEN DELAYED BY APPROXIMATELY FORTY MINUTES DUE TO A SIGNALLING FAULT BETWEEN STOCKPORT AND CREWE. WE APOLOGISE FOR THE INCONVENIENCE AND ADVISE TRAVELLERS WITH ONWARD CONNECTIONS TO SPEAK TO A MEMBER OF STATION STAFF, WHO ARE AVAILABLE ON PLATFORM THREE AND AT THE TICKET BARRIER NEAR THE MAIN CONCOURSE EXIT.

OUR DEMAND IS SIMPLE AND IT HAS NOT CHANGED IN SIX MONTHS. CANCEL THE CONTRACT, PUBLISH THE FIGURES, AND LET THE PUBLIC SEE WHERE THEIR MONEY HAS GONE. WE ARE NOT ASKING FOR CHARITY, WE ARE ASKING FOR HONESTY, AND THE LONGER THEY HIDE FROM US THE LARGER THIS CROWD WILL GROW. WE WILL BE BACK NEXT SATURDAY, AND THE ONE AFTER THAT.

SUNDAY, SUNDAY, SUNDAY, AT THE COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS, WITNESS THE MOST EXPLOSIVE NIGHT OF MOTORSPORT THIS STATE HAS EVER SEEN. TEN THOUSAND HORSEPOWER, TWELVE-FOOT TYRES, AND A FLOOR OF CRUSHED CARS WAITING TO BE FLATTENED EVEN FURTHER. BRING THE WHOLE FAMILY, BRING YOUR EARPLUGS, AND PREPARE FOR AN EVENING OF PURE AUTOMOTIVE MAYHEM.

THE OVEN HAS BEEN OFF THIS WHOLE TIME. I HAVE BEEN STANDING HERE FOR AN HOUR AND TWENTY MINUTES THINKING THE CHICKEN WAS COOKING AND IT IS, IN FACT, AS RAW AS WHEN I PUT IT IN. THE LITTLE LIGHT INSIDE IS A LIE. THE FAN IS A LIE. THE HEAT, APPARENTLY, IS THE PART THAT IS NEGOTIABLE. WE ARE ORDERING IN. I AM NOT TAKING QUESTIONS.

WHEN I FIRST CAME TO THIS TOWN TWENTY YEARS AGO, THE FACTORY WAS STILL OPEN AND THE HIGH STREET WAS STILL ALIVE. I WATCHED IT FADE, AND I WATCHED THE PEOPLE IN CHARGE SHRUG AND CALL IT PROGRESS. BUT IT WAS NOT PROGRESS, IT WAS NEGLECT, AND TOGETHER, STARTING ON ELECTION DAY, WE ARE GOING TO BRING THIS TOWN BACK TO LIFE.

ON YOUR FEET, RECRUITS! YOU HAVE THIRTY SECONDS TO BE IN FORMATION OUTSIDE THE BARRACKS. ANYONE LATE WILL BE DOING PUSH-UPS UNTIL THE COWS COME HOME. I DO NOT CARE ABOUT YOUR SORE LEGS, YOUR BAD ATTITUDE, OR THE BLISTER YOU'VE BEEN COMPLAINING ABOUT SINCE BREAKFAST. MOVE WITH A PURPOSE OR WE WILL BE OUT HERE ALL NIGHT!

WE NOTICED YOU LEFT SOMETHING IN YOUR BASKET, AND WE DID NOT WANT YOU TO MISS OUT. AS A SPECIAL ONE-TIME GESTURE WE ARE OFFERING YOU A MASSIVE DISCOUNT IF YOU COMPLETE YOUR ORDER IN THE NEXT SIXTY MINUTES. THIS PERSONALISED CODE WILL EXPIRE AT MIDNIGHT AND CANNOT BE REISSUED, SO RETURN TO THE STORE NOW AND TREAT YOURSELF BEFORE THE PRICE GOES BACK UP.

SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH UNTIL 11 P.M. ACROSS MOST OF THE STATE. THE PRIMARY THREATS INCLUDE QUARTER-SIZED HAIL, DAMAGING STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS UP TO SEVENTY MILES PER HOUR, AND THE POSSIBILITY OF ISOLATED TORNADOES AFTER DARK. SECURE LOOSE OUTDOOR FURNITURE AND BRING TRAMPOLINES, PATIO UMBRELLAS, AND TRASH BINS INDOORS OR INTO A GARAGE BEFORE THE LINE OF STORMS ARRIVES.

THE TRAIN NOW STANDING AT PLATFORM FOUR IS THE DELAYED SERVICE TO EDINBURGH WAVERLEY, CALLING AT YORK, NEWCASTLE, AND BERWICK-UPON-TWEED. CUSTOMERS ARE ADVISED THAT SEAT RESERVATIONS ON THIS SERVICE HAVE BEEN SUSPENDED. PLEASE SPREAD ALONG THE FULL LENGTH OF THE PLATFORM AND ALLOW PASSENGERS TO ALIGHT BEFORE BOARDING THE TRAIN.

IN A FEW DAYS THE NEWS CAMERAS WILL PACK UP AND LEAVE THIS TOWN, AND THE QUESTION IS WHAT THEY LEAVE BEHIND. I WANT THEM TO LEAVE BEHIND A MOVEMENT, NOT A MOMENT. A MOVEMENT OF ORDINARY PEOPLE WHO DECIDED THAT THEIR VOICE WAS WORTH RAISING. STAND WITH ME NOW, AND LET US GIVE THIS COUNTRY THE FRESH START IT HAS WAITED SO LONG FOR.

HARBOUR LOG, EVENING. A COLLISION WAS NARROWLY AVOIDED IN THE OUTER ANCHORAGE WHEN A TRAWLER DRAGGED ITS ANCHOR IN THE RISING WIND. THE CREW RECOVERED CONTROL AND RE-ANCHORED IN A SAFER BERTH UNDER OUR DIRECTION. ALL OTHER VESSELS RIDING WELL. THE GLASS CONTINUES TO FALL AND I HAVE WARNED THE SMALL BOATS TO STAY IN PORT TOMORROW.

WE KNOW IT WAS YOU WHO TOOK THE TROPHY FROM THE CLUBHOUSE CABINET. RETURN IT TO THE STEPS BEFORE THE WEEKEND AND NO MORE WILL BE SAID ABOUT THE MATTER. KEEP IT, AND EVERY MEMBER OF THIS CLUB WILL HEAR THE STORY AT THE ANNUAL DINNER, ALONG WITH YOUR NAME. THE CHOICE IS SIMPLE AND THE DEADLINE IS NOT NEGOTIABLE.

WE ARE NOW STANDING IN THE EGYPTIAN ROOM, WHERE I WOULD LIKE TO DRAW YOUR ATTENTION TO THE PAINTED COFFIN ALONG THE WEST WALL. THIS PIECE BELONGED TO A MINOR TEMPLE OFFICIAL FROM THEBES, AND THE HIEROGLYPHS ALONG THE LID DESCRIBE HIS DAILY DUTIES IN UNUSUAL DETAIL. THE PIGMENTS REMAIN REMARKABLY VIVID AFTER MORE THAN THREE THOUSAND YEARS.

BREAKING: LOCAL COUNCIL VOTES TO APPROVE CONTROVERSIAL HOUSING DEVELOPMENT ON GREEN BELT LAND AFTER A FIVE-HOUR PUBLIC HEARING. RESIDENTS' GROUPS HAVE VOWED TO APPEAL THE DECISION, CITING CONCERNS OVER FLOOD RISK AND PRESSURE ON LOCAL SCHOOLS. THE DEVELOPER HAS WELCOMED THE OUTCOME AND SAYS CONSTRUCTION ON THE FIRST PHASE OF 240 HOMES WILL BEGIN BEFORE THE END OF THE FINANCIAL YEAR.

THEY SAY WE CANNOT AFFORD TO FIX OUR SCHOOLS AND OUR HOSPITALS. I SAY WE CANNOT AFFORD NOT TO. EVERY POUND WE INVEST IN A CHILD'S EDUCATION COMES BACK TO US TENFOLD IN A DOCTOR, A SCIENTIST, A SKILLED AND CONFIDENT CITIZEN. THIS IS NOT SPENDING, FRIENDS, THIS IS BUILDING, AND IT IS TIME WE STARTED BUILDING AGAIN.

GATES OPEN AT FIVE, THE SHOW STARTS AT SEVEN, AND THE PARTY DOES NOT STOP UNTIL THE LAST TRUCK ROLLS BACK INTO THE PITS. CONCESSIONS WILL BE SELLING BURGERS, HOT DOGS, AND SODA THE SIZE OF SMALL BUCKETS. WEAR SOMETHING YOU DO NOT MIND GETTING DUSTY, AND GET READY FOR THE LOUDEST NIGHT OF YOUR ENTIRE LIFE.

FOR OUR NEXT ACT I MUST ASK FOR COMPLETE AND UTTER SILENCE THROUGHOUT THE TENT. THE KNIFE THROWER REQUIRES PERFECT CONCENTRATION, AND SO, I CAN ASSURE YOU, DOES HIS LOVELY ASSISTANT, WHO HAS GENEROUSLY AGREED TO STAND VERY STILL INDEED AGAINST THAT SPINNING WOODEN WHEEL FOR THE NEXT THREE BREATHTAKING MINUTES.

THIS NEXT GROUP HAS TRAVELLED OVER THREE HUNDRED MILES TO BE WITH US TONIGHT, AND THEY HAVE BEEN REHEARSING IN A CHURCH HALL SINCE LAST WINTER. THEY ARE NERVOUS, THEY TOLD ME SO, BUT THEY ARE ALSO READY. SO LET US FILL THIS THEATRE WITH THE KIND OF APPLAUSE THAT MAKES NERVOUS PEOPLE BRAVE. HERE THEY ARE NOW.

GERMAN SHEPHERD CROSS, GOES BY 'TANK', WENT MISSING FROM THE BACK GARDEN ON ROSEWOOD DRIVE EARLIER THIS WEEK. LARGE FRAME, BLACK AND TAN COAT, ONE EAR FLOPS DOWN. HE IS WEARING A REINFORCED COLLAR WITH AN ENGRAVED METAL TAG. PLEASE DO NOT APPROACH IF YOU SEE HIM; CALL THE NUMBER PROVIDED AND WE WILL COME COLLECT HIM. REWARD AVAILABLE.

MAY I REMIND SPECTATORS THAT THE SCORE NOW SHOWS A REQUIRED RATE OF ALMOST ELEVEN RUNS AN OVER, A STIFF ASK ON ANY SURFACE. THE BATTING SIDE HAVE FORTY-EIGHT TO GET FROM THE LAST FIVE OVERS WITH FOUR WICKETS IN HAND. THE CROWD ARE IN FINE VOICE, AND THIS GAME IS POISED BEAUTIFULLY FOR A DRAMATIC FINAL FEW MINUTES.

FAIR ISLE, FAEROES, SOUTH-EAST ICELAND. WIND CYCLONIC BECOMING WESTERLY SIX TO GALE EIGHT. SEA STATE ROUGH OR VERY ROUGH, BECOMING HIGH FOR A TIME. WEATHER WINTRY SHOWERS. VISIBILITY GOOD, OCCASIONALLY POOR. ICE ACCRETION IS A SIGNIFICANT RISK ON EXPOSED SUPERSTRUCTURE, AND MASTERS ARE URGED TO TAKE THE APPROPRIATE PRECAUTIONS.

OUR RABBIT IS MISSING! 'CARROT' IS A LARGE BROWN LIONHEAD WHO DUG UNDER THE HUTCH AND ESCAPED INTO THE GARDEN SOMETIME OVERNIGHT. HE IS USED TO BEING HANDLED AND WILL OFTEN HOP TOWARDS PEOPLE RATHER THAN AWAY. PLEASE CHECK UNDER SHEDS, IN COMPOST HEAPS, AND ANYWHERE WITH DENSE GROUND COVER. THE CHILDREN ARE DEVASTATED. PLEASE GET IN TOUCH IF SEEN.

PLEASE STEP CLOSER, BUT DO NOT TOUCH THE GLASS. THIS IS THE ORIGINAL MANUSCRIPT, IN THE AUTHOR'S OWN HAND, WITH MARGIN NOTES AND CROSSINGS-OUT THAT REVEAL HOW DRAMATICALLY THE FINAL CHAPTER WAS REVISED DURING THE WINTER OF 1862. THE INK HAS FADED, OF COURSE, BUT YOU CAN STILL READ THE WORD 'TERRIBLE', UNDERLINED THREE TIMES, IN THE TOP MARGIN.

DO NOT BE ALARMED BY THE DARKNESS, MY FRIENDS, FOR IT IS ONLY THE PRELUDE TO WONDER. WHEN THE SPOTLIGHT RETURNS, IT WILL FIND OUR MASTER ILLUSIONIST STANDING WHERE A MOMENT AGO THERE WAS NOTHING AT ALL. KEEP YOUR EYES WIDE AND YOUR MINDS WIDER, FOR WHAT YOU ARE ABOUT TO SEE CANNOT BE EXPLAINED BY ANY HONEST PERSON.

DINER, BREAKFAST SERVED ALL DAY, BOTTOMLESS COFFEE. THE TALL SIGN ON ITS METAL POLE HAS BEEN A FRIEND TO ROAD-WEARY DRIVERS SINCE THE HIGHWAY FIRST CUT THROUGH THE VALLEY. SLIDE INTO A CHROME-EDGED BOOTH, ORDER THE PANCAKES, AND LET THE WAITRESS REFILL YOUR CUP UNTIL YOU FEEL ALMOST HUMAN AGAIN AND READY FOR THE LONG MILES STILL AHEAD.

WAIT WAIT WAIT WAIT. ARE WE TALKING ABOUT THE SAME RESTAURANT. THE ONE BY THE CANAL. THE ONE WHERE THE WAITER FORGOT ABOUT US FOR AN HOUR. THE ONE WHERE THE LASAGNA WAS, AND I QUOTE, 'STRUCTURALLY INSULTING'. THAT RESTAURANT? YOU WANT TO GO BACK THERE. FOR A BIRTHDAY. I AM JUST CHECKING BEFORE I CHANGE THE NAME OF THIS CHAT.

WATER YOUR NEW TOMATO PLANTS DEEPLY EVERY TWO TO THREE DAYS DURING WARM WEATHER, AIMING THE WATER AT THE BASE RATHER THAN THE LEAVES. PINCH OUT THE SIDE SHOOTS AS THEY APPEAR TO ENCOURAGE A SINGLE STRONG MAIN STEM. FEED WEEKLY WITH A HIGH-POTASSIUM TOMATO FOOD ONCE THE FIRST TRUSS OF FRUIT HAS SET, AND STAKE THE PLANTS SECURELY TO PROTECT THEM FROM WIND.

TO YOUR LEFT, BEHIND THE ROPE, IS A FULLY FUNCTIONAL EARLY TYPEWRITER FROM 1874. NOTICE THE ARRANGEMENT OF THE KEYS, WHICH WILL LOOK ODD TO MODERN EYES. THIS IS, IN FACT, THE FIRST COMMERCIAL KEYBOARD TO USE THE QWERTY LAYOUT WE STILL USE TODAY. IT WAS DESIGNED TO REDUCE JAMMING, NOT, AS LEGEND SUGGESTS, TO SLOW THE TYPIST DOWN.

I AM SO SORRY. I AM SO INCREDIBLY SORRY. I TYPED THAT WHOLE THING ABOUT KAREN AND I MEANT TO SEND IT TO RACHEL AND I SENT IT TO THE WORK CHAT INSTEAD. I HAVE DELETED IT BUT EVERYONE SAW IT. KAREN HAS NOT REPLIED. KAREN HAS GONE QUIET. I MAY BE GETTING FIRED. I MAY BE MOVING. I HAVE ALREADY STARTED PACKING. PLEASE SAY SOMETHING.

DISAPPEARED FROM THE BACK FENCE OVERNIGHT! WE FEAR OUR INDOOR CAT, 'MARMALADE', WAS LET OUT BY ACCIDENT WHEN THE WINDOW REPAIRMAN CAME ON THURSDAY. ORANGE-AND-WHITE LONG-HAIRED MALE, BIG GREEN EYES, EXTREMELY FLUFFY. HE HAS NEVER BEEN OUTSIDE BEFORE AND WILL BE HIDING. PLEASE CHECK YOUR SHEDS AND CALL US IF YOU SPOT HIM. WE ARE FRANTIC.

EVERYTHING MUST GO! FINAL CLEARANCE! UP TO 75 PERCENT OFF ORIGINAL PRICES ON ALL REMAINING SUMMER STOCK. INCLUDES SWIMWEAR, SANDALS, SUNDRESSES, AND SELECTED FOOTWEAR. NO HOLDS, NO RETURNS, NO EXCHANGES. CASH AND CARD ACCEPTED. WHEN IT'S GONE, IT'S GONE. SALE ENDS SUNDAY AT 6 P.M. SHARP, SO GET DOWN HERE BEFORE YOUR SIZE WALKS OUT THE DOOR ON SOMEONE ELSE.

THEY SAID THE MISSION WAS IMPOSSIBLE. THEY SAID NO ONE COULD CROSS THE DESERT AND LIVE. THIS SPRING, A SMALL BAND OF STRANGERS WILL PROVE THEM ALL WRONG, OR DIE TRYING. FROM THE FIRST GUNSHOT TO THE FINAL SUNRISE, THIS IS A TALE OF GRIT, BETRAYAL, AND THE STUBBORN HUMAN REFUSAL TO GIVE UP WHEN EVERY SINGLE SIGN SAYS THAT YOU SHOULD.

OH MY GOODNESS, WHAT A FINISH AT THE WIRE! THE FAVOURITE COMES CHARGING DOWN THE STRETCH, EVEN MONEY THERE AT THE EIGHTH POLE, AND IS RUN DOWN BY THE LONGSHOT IN THE FINAL STRIDE! PHOTO FINISH AT CHURCHILL DOWNS AND THE STEWARDS WILL HAVE TO SORT OUT THE PLACINGS, BUT IT LOOKED FROM THE BOOTH LIKE A BOBBING HEAD AT EXACTLY THE RIGHT MOMENT FOR NUMBER NINE.

ON THE MORNING OF THE GREAT MATCH THE SKY OVER THE STADIUM FILLED WITH SMOKE-WHITE LETTERS SPELLING OUT THE NAME OF THE HOME TEAM AND A SINGLE TRIUMPHANT WORD OF ENCOURAGEMENT. THOUSANDS OF SUPPORTERS QUEUING OUTSIDE THE TURNSTILES CHEERED AS THE MESSAGE HUNG THERE, PERFECT FOR A MINUTE, BEFORE THE BREEZE SOFTENED IT INTO A PALE GREY HAZE.

I DO NOT WANT TO HEAR ANOTHER ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE SAME ATTORNEY FROM THE SAME RADIO STATION. I HAVE BEEN INFORMED FORTY-SEVEN TIMES THAT IF I HAVE BEEN INJURED IN AN ACCIDENT I MAY BE ENTITLED TO COMPENSATION. I HAVE NOT BEEN IN AN ACCIDENT. THE ACCIDENT IS UP AHEAD, BLOCKING ALL THREE LANES, AND I AM ABOUT TO BECOME ITS NEXT VICTIM EMOTIONALLY.

EVERY SINGLE TIME I TAKE THIS EXIT. EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. I LEAVE THE HOUSE TWENTY MINUTES EARLY, I CHECK THE TRAFFIC APP, I CONSULT THE LOCAL NEWS, I LIGHT A CANDLE FOR THE COMMUTING GODS, AND STILL THE M25 BETWEEN JUNCTIONS TEN AND TWELVE BECOMES A LINEAR CAR PARK BETWEEN THE HOURS OF FOUR AND SEVEN. I AM CONSIDERING BUYING A HORSE.

LOG ENTRY FOR THE WINTER SOLSTICE. THE SHORTEST DAY AND ONE OF THE COLDEST. ICE FORMED ON THE GALLERY HANDRAIL AND WAS CHIPPED AWAY BEFORE THE EVENING ROUNDS. THE LIGHT WAS LIT EARLY DUE TO THE GLOOM. NO SHIPPING SEEN ALL DAY. THE KEEPER'S CAT REMAINS THE ONLY OTHER LIVING SOUL ON THE ROCK AND IS, AS EVER, EXCELLENT COMPANY.

INTO THE FAR TURN AND THE FIELD IS BUNCHING UP, EVERY JOCKEY LOOKING FOR ROOM. THE LONGSHOT FROM POST TWELVE HAS BEEN SAVING GROUND ALL DAY AND IS NOW THREADING THROUGH HORSES LIKE A NEEDLE. THIS COULD BE THE RIDE OF THE MEETING IF THAT GAP STAYS OPEN, BECAUSE HE IS FULL OF RUNNING AND ASKING TO GO.

sentence: MEANWHILE, ACROSS THE RAIN-SLICKED CITY, A SHADOW MOVES BETWEEN THE ROOFTOPS. KAPOW, THE FIRST BLOW LANDS SQUARE ON THE VILLAIN'S JAW, AND HE STAGGERS BACKWARD TOWARD THE EDGE OF THE BUILDING. BUT OUR HERO IS NOT FINISHED YET, FOR THE NIGHT IS YOUNG AND JUSTICE, AS EVERY READER KNOWS, NEVER SLEEPS UNTIL THE LAST PAGE IS TURNED.

RECORDS BOUGHT AND SOLD, RARE VINYL, OPEN TILL MIDNIGHT FRIDAYS. THE FLICKERING SIGN HAS LURED CRATE-DIGGERS DOWN THIS NARROW ALLEY FOR THIRTY YEARS. PUSH THROUGH THE BEADED CURTAIN INTO A WARM ROOM THAT SMELLS OF CARDBOARD AND DUST, WHERE EVERY SLEEVE HOLDS A POSSIBILITY AND THE MAN BEHIND THE COUNTER KNOWS EXACTLY WHERE EVERYTHING IS.

THE RECIPE FOR YOUR FAMOUS SAUCE IS NO LONGER A SECRET, AND WE ARE PREPARED TO HAND IT TO EVERY RIVAL RESTAURANT ON THE STREET. BUT WE ARE BUSINESS PEOPLE, NOT VANDALS. PAY WHAT WE ASK, AND THE ONLY COPY WILL BE BURNED IN FRONT OF YOU. REFUSE, AND BY NEXT WEEK YOUR SIGNATURE DISH WILL BE ON EVERY MENU IN THE CITY.

STORE CLOSING SALE! AFTER FORTY-THREE YEARS ON THIS HIGH STREET, WE ARE RETIRING. EVERY ITEM REDUCED. FIXTURES, FITTINGS, AND DISPLAY UNITS ALSO FOR SALE. WE WANT TO THANK OUR LOYAL CUSTOMERS FOR DECADES OF SUPPORT AND ENCOURAGE EVERYONE TO COME IN ONE LAST TIME BEFORE WE LOCK THE DOORS FOR GOOD ON THE THIRTY-FIRST OF THE MONTH.

RAIN OR SHINE WE WILL BE HERE, AND TODAY IT IS RAIN, AND STILL WE HAVE COME IN OUR THOUSANDS. LOOK AROUND YOU AT THE FACES, YOUNG AND OLD, FROM EVERY CORNER OF THIS TOWN. THIS IS NOT A FRINGE, THIS IS NOT A MINORITY, THIS IS THE PEOPLE, AND THE PEOPLE ARE TELLING THEIR LEADERS THAT THE STATUS QUO IS NO LONGER ACCEPTABLE.

I DO NOT WANT TO HEAR ABOUT YOUR BAD DAY AT WORK. I REALLY DO NOT. WHEN YOU WALK THROUGH THAT DOOR, EVERYTHING OUT THERE STAYS OUT THERE. IN HERE THERE IS ONLY THE NEXT SET, THE NEXT REP, AND THE NEXT BREATH. THAT IS WHY YOU CAME. TO TURN OFF THE NOISE. TO REMEMBER WHAT YOUR BODY CAN DO. NOW LET'S GO. THE BAR IS WAITING.

WE ARE SO CLOSE TO THE TARGET THAT I CAN ALMOST TASTE IT, JUST EIGHT THOUSAND POUNDS STAND BETWEEN US AND A RECORD-BREAKING NIGHT. EIGHT THOUSAND. THINK ABOUT HOW MANY OF US ARE WATCHING. IF WE PULL TOGETHER FOR THESE NEXT TEN MINUTES, WE WILL NOT JUST REACH THE GOAL, WE WILL LEAVE IT FAR BEHIND US.

GATHER ROUND, GATHER ROUND, FOR THE STRANGEST SIGHT YOUR EYES WILL EVER BEHOLD. INSIDE THIS TENT, AND ONLY INSIDE THIS TENT, YOU WILL WITNESS WONDERS THAT DEFY ALL EXPLANATION. THE TICKET IS A SMALL PRICE FOR A MEMORY THAT WILL LAST A LIFETIME, AND I PROMISE YOU WILL BE TELLING THIS STORY AT EVERY DINNER TABLE FOR YEARS TO COME.

FROM THE FAR CORNERS OF THE WORLD, OVER LAND AND OVER SEA, THEY HAVE TRAVELLED TO BE WITH YOU TONIGHT, AND I PRESENT THEM TO YOU NOW WITH ENORMOUS PRIDE. THE FLYING FAMILY, FOUR GENERATIONS OF ACROBATS, WHO WILL SOAR THROUGH THE AIR ABOVE YOUR HEADS AS THOUGH GRAVITY ITSELF HAD KINDLY AGREED TO TAKE THE EVENING OFF.

THE STRIKER COLLECTS IT JUST INSIDE THE EIGHTEEN, TURNS HIS DEFENDER WITH A LOVELY BIT OF SKILL, AND PUTS IT TOP CORNER! THE GOALKEEPER NEVER MOVED! THIS HAS BEEN A MASTERCLASS FROM THE NUMBER NINE TODAY AND THE TRAVELLING SUPPORTERS BEHIND THAT GOAL ARE SINGING HIS NAME. WHAT A WAY TO OPEN THE SCORING IN A MATCH THAT MEANS EVERYTHING TO BOTH SIDES.

WOULD THE OWNER OF A WHITE HATCHBACK PARKED ON LEVEL THREE OF THE MULTI-STOREY PLEASE RETURN TO THEIR VEHICLE, WHERE THE LIGHTS HAVE BEEN LEFT ON. ALTERNATIVELY, PLEASE REPORT TO THE CAR PARK OFFICE NEAR THE PEDESTRIAN EXIT. WE WOULD HATE FOR YOU TO RETURN AFTER A LONG DAY OF SHOPPING TO FIND A BATTERY THAT WILL NOT START.

I DID NOT DO IT. I HAVE BEEN TRYING TO SAY THIS FOR EIGHT MONTHS AND NOBODY IN THIS BUILDING HAS BEEN WILLING TO LISTEN. I WAS NOT IN THE CITY. I CAN PRODUCE THE BOARDING PASS, THE HOTEL RECEIPT, THE TAXI RECORDS, THE TEXT MESSAGES, AND THE TWELVE EYEWITNESSES, AND STILL WE ARE HERE. THIS IS THE JUSTICE SYSTEM AT ITS WORST.

WHAT A FINISH WE HAVE WITNESSED HERE TODAY. AT THE WIRE IT WAS THE FILLY BY A NOSE, A DESPERATE LUNGE THAT CAUGHT THE LEADER IN THE FINAL STRIDE. THE PHOTO IS BEING DEVELOPED, THE NUMBERS ARE NOT YET POSTED, BUT FROM THE TOWER IT LOOKED LIKE THE BRAVE OUTSIDER GOT HER HEAD DOWN AT EXACTLY THE RIGHT INSTANT.

CONGRATULATIONS, YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS HAS BEEN SELECTED IN OUR ANNUAL INTERNATIONAL DRAW AND YOU ARE THE CONFIRMED WINNER OF A SUBSTANTIAL CASH PRIZE. TO CLAIM YOUR WINNINGS YOU MUST REPLY WITHIN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS WITH YOUR FULL NAME, DATE OF BIRTH, AND BANKING DETAILS SO OUR PROCESSING AGENT CAN RELEASE THE FUNDS DIRECTLY INTO YOUR ACCOUNT WITHOUT FURTHER DELAY.
